item.title: How Dolly Parton wrote the story of a changing America
item.description: Parton, who died at 80 on Tuesday, had charm, depth, beauty, wit and radiant goodness. She was also a songwriter whose work told the story not just of country music but of the country itself.

item.description: The price of electricity is soaring in the summer heat, when fans and air conditioners are working nonstop. In Tulsa, Okla., people are having their power cut when they can't pay their bills.

item.title: Hollywood's summer box office is glowing, but the numbers come with startling caveats
item.description: Theaters have had something for everyone this summer, and fans are paying top dollar for premium formats like IMAX. There are also fewer moviegoers, fewer movies and fewer screens than there were pre-COVID.

item.title: Hospital nursery fire kills 14 newborns in Pakistan's capital, officials order immediate inquiry
item.description: A fire erupted early Wednesday in a nursery for newborns at a major government hospital in Pakistan's capital, killing 14 babies, according to hospital officials and the government.
